extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in television, comedy, and entertainment industry news (fans, industry observers)
extracted.subtask_description: A short news-style obituary / career summary for a stand-up comedian and television personality, describing life, notable career highlights, style, and circumstances of death. Fits entertainment-industry press or trade publication format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Known for his sharp observational humor and often scorching rants
rubrics_metrics.description: “Known for his sharp observational humor and often scorching rants, Giraldo was a favorite of other comics, including Jim Norton, Sarah Silverman, Louis C.K. and many others.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article presents distinctive comedic voice (sharp observation + scorching rants) as a defining quality and implicit criterion of Giraldo's success and esteem among peers; use such stylistic descriptors to explain why a comedian was influential or respected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regular appearances on late-night talk shows and celebrity roasts
rubrics_metrics.description: Giraldo “was a regular on late-night talk shows and celebrity roasts,” with bookings on programs such as Late Night with Conan O’Brien, Jimmy Kimmel Live, and Comedy Central roasts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Television visibility and recurring bookings on high-profile talk shows and roasts are presented as evidence of professional success and mainstream recognition; list notable shows/appearances to demonstrate impact and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roles on television and participation in comedy programs/competitions
rubrics_metrics.description: He was “known to primetime viewers as a judge on NBC’s Last Comic Standing,” appeared on Comedy Central programs (Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn, Root of All Evil), played an attorney on ABC’s Common Law, and guest-starred on The Marriage Ref.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citing diverse TV roles (judge, performer, actor) and participation in televised competitions or panel shows serves to document career breadth; include specific programs and contexts to situate the subject in the television/comedy ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal and professional background (education and prior career)
rubrics_metrics.description: Biographical details: born in New York City (1965); earned a bachelor’s degree from Columbia University and a law degree from Harvard; worked at the Manhattan law firm Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom before committing to comedy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Including notable education and prior professional background provides context for the subject’s career trajectory and can underscore unusual or notable aspects of their path into comedy (e.g., switching from a prestigious law career).

rubrics_metrics.name: Circumstances of death and family details
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported facts: died September 29, 2010, at age 44; admitted to the hospital following an accidental overdose of prescription medication; divorced with three children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obituary-style reporting requires concise factual statements about death (date, place, cause as reported) and immediate survivors; present reported cause carefully and attribute to news reports when appropriate.
